svg.title: Waveform and visualization modes
svg.desc: Mirrored bars, spectrum, oscilloscope and static reduced-motion presentation with honest signal semantics.
svg.text: One signal source, multiple presentations. Decorative motion never masquerades as audio analysis.
Primary mode · time-domain envelope · played/unplayed distinction
Log-spaced bands · peak caps · no fake stereo
Time-domain trace · stable centerline · clipped samples flagged
Album art remains visible; signal updates can be paused or hidden without affecting audio
Color + shape + labels distinguish modes. Peak meters are analysis measurements, not a promise about device output.
Default: no flashing, no camera-like zoom, no continuous rotation. Full motion is an explicit preference.
